en: Episode 23 — The Night Barman: a barman sells napkins to a fed; tail, sneak, choose, drop.
zh: 第二十三集《夜班酒保》：酒保把餐巾紙賣給聯邦探員；跟蹤、潛行、抉擇、投遞。

en: Episode 22 — The Fern Man: a fed asks Gina about Enzo; carry a fern, eavesdrop, chase.
zh: 第二十二集《蕨類男人》：聯邦探員向吉娜打聽恩佐；護送蕨類、偷聽、追車。

en: Episode 21 — Each Way: Kilbane meets a fed; tail, ask around, ram, swap a notebook.
zh: 第二十一集《兩頭下注》：基爾本私會聯邦探員；跟蹤、查問、撞車、偷換筆記本。

en: Episode Twenty — Sleepy Biscotti: Benny runs a school betting book; tail, eavesdrop, sneak.
zh: 第二十集《瞌睡餅乾》：班尼在學校做起賭馬生意；跟蹤、偷聽、潛入。

en: Episode Nineteen — Four in the Morning: the Rolling Pin chase now ends when Dario is cornered.
zh: 第十九集《凌晨四點》：「擀麵棍」追逐戰中，把達里歐逼到死角就算抓到。

en: Episode Eighteen — Question Marks: a pier stake-out, a rat on the run, six new missions.
zh: 第十八集《問號》：碼頭埋伏、抓捕告密者，六個新任務。

en: Episode Seventeen — A Nice One: copied photos, a motel break-in, six new missions.
zh: 第十七集《好照片》：被翻印的照片、潛入汽車旅館，六個新任務。

en: Episode Sixteen — The Brown Sedan: a fed on the pier, a test for Enzo, six new missions.
zh: 第十六集《棕色轎車》：碼頭上的探員、對恩佐的考驗，六個新任務。

en: Episode Fifteen — The Button: a sit-down, a stolen pickup of olive oil, six new missions.
zh: 第十五集《按鈕》：一場談判、一輛偷來的橄欖油小貨車，六個新任務。

en: Episode Fourteen — Anytime: who talks to the F.B.I.? Six new missions, ending in cannoli.
zh: 第十四集《隨時》：誰在跟聯邦調查局說話？六個新任務，最後是一盒奶油卷。

en: Episode Thirteen — The Return Address: Joey is back in town; six new missions, from a postcard to the night truck.
zh: 第十三集《回信地址》：喬伊回來了；六個新任務，從一張明信片到深夜的卡車。

en: Phones: the game needs much less memory while it loads, so iPhones (and in-app browsers) no longer close the tab before the title.
zh: 手機：載入時用的記憶體大幅減少，iPhone（和App內建瀏覽器）不會再在標題畫面前就關掉分頁。

en: Episode Twelve — The Nice Tie: a long-lens tail, a darkroom, a sit-down and a night drive.
zh: 第十二集〈漂亮領帶〉：遠鏡頭跟蹤、暗房、談判，還有一趟深夜車程。

en: Episode Ten — The Waiting Room: a stake-out, a sneaky card, a chase and lunch with Sergio.
zh: 第十集〈候診室〉：埋伏監視、偷放名片、追逐，還有和Sergio吃午飯。

en: Il Gabbiano's dining room and kitchen are open.
zh: Il Gabbiano 的餐廳和廚房開放了。

en: Characters now talk and blink when they speak.
zh: 角色說話時會動嘴巴、會眨眼了。

en: Nico's house is open: walk into the Bellacosta home.
zh: Nico 的家開放了：走進 Bellacosta 家。

en: Port Paloma opens faster, and shows you how far along it is.
zh: Port Paloma 開得更快，還會顯示載入進度。

en: Every mission now has a medal to earn and a bonus goal.
zh: 每個任務都有獎牌可拿，還有一個額外挑戰。

en: Phones: scenes that need a key now show it, and tapping Use works as well as holding.
zh: 手機：需要按鍵的場景會顯示提示，點按「使用」和按住一樣有效。

en: New: this What's new card. See what changed, every day.
zh: 新增：「最新更新」卡片，每天的改動都在這裡。

en: Lost on a drive? The marker now pulses and a hint shows the way.
zh: 開車找不到路？標記會閃動，還有提示幫你指路。

en: Phones: Punch is always at hand, and every button has an icon.
zh: 手機：「揮拳」隨時可按，每個按鈕都有圖示。

en: Phones no longer crash when you walk into a building.
zh: 手機走進建築物不會再當掉。

en: Hold your phone upright and the game turns sideways for you.
zh: 手機直拿也能玩：畫面會自動轉成橫向。

en: Port Paloma opens on the web: free, in your browser.
zh: Port Paloma 上線：免費、用瀏覽器就能玩。
